title: The Effect of a Father Inclusive Psychoeducation Program on Postnatal Depression
brief_summary: Study hypothesis: Childbearing couples who receive the father inclusive psychoeducation program will have: (a) a lower level of depressive symptoms, (b) a higher level of marital relationship, and (c) a higher level of quality of life at 6 weeks, 6 months and one year postpartum than those who receive the usual perinatal care.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* aged 18 or above;
* first-time parents;
* able to speak and read the Chinese language; and
* Hong Kong residents.

Exclusion Criteria:

* couples with past or family psychiatric history
